title: 第一卷 第2427章 一对阴阳鱼第一卷 第2426章 九妙阴阳道莲
content_zh:
九妙阴阳道莲。
其内部拥有九条道气，以阴阳大道为基础，辅助提升九个方面的力量。
阴阳，毕竟是整个世界最为基础的力量之一，天下万物万灵，都有阴阳之分，天地初开之时阴阳便已出现。
也因如此，阴阳大道的易用性才非常高，也便有了九妙阴阳道莲这样的神迹，可以拥有难以想象的妙用。
林辰感受着九妙阴阳道莲的力量，九种特性的提升，可以自行选择。
速度，肉身强度，敏锐，感知，神魂力量，属性力量等等，各种细分的特性，不管强弱，都能够有所升华。
不过林辰感受了一番，很快便是有些失望。
对他来说，这提升实在是有限。
他各个方面的力量，都锤炼得太强了，已经是现有境界能够达到的极致，甚至是极致之上，这种程度的力量，的确是九妙阴阳道莲也无能为力的地步。
根本帮不上什么忙。
“差点意思，不过也是，在这阴阳道莲中的，大部分都是神皇，神王，神君几乎没有，夏侯家会这么安排，也是因为对神君意义已经没有那么大”，林辰低语道。
当然，即便如此，并不代表这九妙阴阳道莲作用就小了。
起码夏侯家的神君，不是不屑使用，而是都已经使用过了，无法继续提升，才会将机会让给年轻人。
并不是他们看不上。
“对小莹他们，帮助还是不小的，不过对骆前辈，作用就没多少了”，林辰道。
不过他的目标本也不是这九妙阴阳道莲，他想要的，是夏侯家还未挖掘的力量，或许不存在，但总要试一试。
当下林辰依样画葫芦，以阴阳天通经催动阴阳之环，随即沟通阴阳生死咒。
再探此地虚实！
“也不知道这阴阳庙祝的阴阳大道比之诸子草堂的阴阳家如何，一年之期已到，如今的林皇应该已经进入诸子草堂了吧，掌握阴阳道的他，鸿蒙大道是否更上一个台阶？”林辰感受着此地的阴阳之力。
心中自然想起了人间的经历。

人间的阴阳道，可也是有着极深的研究，阴阳家的力量更是匪夷所思。
如那阴阳之祖，早在神界大墟还未开启的过去，便是进入其中，并且夺取了九宗物件之一的光源，手段可称逆天。
若是活到现在，想必其阴阳道的造诣，怕是不输阴阳庙祝亦或者当今神界的阴阳道君。
不过阴阳之祖不知道是否还活着，但阴阳家的传承还是在的，有朝一日，兴许会引发大动静。
可惜他们没有进入神界，不然或许可以得到更多。
当然，也有可能提前引来灭顶之灾。
林辰心中念头转动，人间如何他的确在很在意，也不知道亿兆天衍盘还能够遮蔽天机到几时。
加快强大自身，夺取资源，顺便培植力量，才是眼下的关键！
“有了！”
某一瞬间，林辰眸光顿时一亮。
他感觉到了！
阴阳生死咒果然有所变动。
不愧是女神亲手布置的力量，的确蕴含着无法被现在的林辰所理解的力量，高过着阴阳庙太多了。
林辰只是利用其作为探查媒介，便几乎无往不利。
“这波动，这气息，比之极阴冥骨都不遑多让！”林辰眼睛大亮，心中不由激动起来。
夏侯家到底还是没能对阴阳庙完成彻底的探索，没有去动着阴阳惊天阵的核心，以至于他们耗费了如此漫长的岁月，也没能探清所有的造化。
在这第二重庙宇，这阴阳道莲自然是无上瑰宝，足以让世人艳羡。
content_en:
Nine Wonderful Yin Yang Dao Lotus.
There are nine Tao Qi inside it, based on the Yin and Yang Avenue, to assist in improving the power in nine aspects.
Yin and Yang, after all, are one of the most basic forces in the entire world. All living things in the world are divided into Yin and Yang. Yin and Yang appeared when the world first opened.
Because of this, the ease of use of Yin Yang Dao is very high, and there are miracles like Jiu Miao Yin Yang Dao Lotus, which can have unimaginable magical effects.
Lin Chen felt the power of Jiu Miao Yin Yang Dao Lian, and he could choose the improvement of nine characteristics.
Speed, physical strength, acuity, perception, soul power, attribute power, etc. Various subdivided characteristics, no matter strong or weak, can be sublimated.
However, Lin Chen felt it for a while and soon became a little disappointed.
For him, this improvement is really limited.
His strength in all aspects has been tempered so much that it has reached the extreme that the current state can achieve, or even beyond the extreme. This level of power is indeed beyond the power of the Jiu Miao Yin Yang Dao Lian.
Not much help at all.
"I almost didn't mean it, but that's right. Most of the people in this Yin Yang Dao Lotus are divine emperors, divine kings, and almost no divine monarchs. The Xiahou family would arrange this because it no longer means so much to the divine monarchs," Lin Chen whispered.
Of course, even so, it does not mean that the effect of the Nine Wonderful Yin and Yang Dao Lotus is small.
At least the divine kings of the Xiahou family did not disdain to use them, but they had already used them and could not continue to improve, so they gave the opportunity to young people.
It's not that they don't like it.
"For Xiaoying and the others, it's still a big help, but for Senior Luo, it's not that useful," Lin Chen said.
However, his goal is not the Nine Wonders of Yin and Yang Daolian. What he wants is the power that the Xiahou family has not yet explored. It may not exist, but he must give it a try.
At the moment, Lin Chen drew the gourd in the same way, using the yin and yang heaven to stimulate the ring of yin and yang, and then communicated the yin and yang life and death mantra.
Let’s explore the reality of this place again!
"I don't know how the Yin-Yang Avenue of the Yin-Yang Temple is compared to the Yin-Yang Family of the Zhuzi Thatched Cottage. The one-year period has come, and Emperor Lin should have entered the Zhuzi Thatched Cottage. Now that he has mastered the Yin-Yang Dao, can the Hongmeng Avenue be taken to a higher level?" Lin Chen felt the power of Yin and Yang here.
Naturally, the human experience came to mind.
The Yin and Yang Dao in the human world is also deeply studied, and the power of the Yin and Yang family is even more unbelievable.
For example, the ancestor of Yin and Yang entered the Great Ruins of the God Realm long before it was opened, and seized the light source of one of the nine objects. His method was unparalleled.
If he were alive to this day, his attainments in Yin-Yang Dao would probably not be inferior to that of Yin-Yang Temple Zhu or the Yin-Yang Dao Lord of the current God Realm.
However, it is not known whether the ancestor of Yin Yang is still alive, but the inheritance of the Yin Yang family is still there, and one day, it may cause a big disturbance.
It's a pity that they didn't enter the God Realm, otherwise they might have gotten more.
Of course, it is also possible to cause disaster in advance.
Lin Chen's thoughts were spinning in his mind. He really cared about what happened to the world, and he didn't know how long the billion-trillion celestial disk would be able to cover up the secrets of heaven.
Speeding up to strengthen oneself, seizing resources, and cultivating strength at the same time is the key right now!
"Yes!"
At a certain moment, Lin Chen's eyes suddenly lit up.
He felt it!
The Yin Yang Life and Death Curse has indeed changed.
It is indeed the power arranged by the goddess herself. It does contain power that cannot be understood by Lin Chen now. It is much higher than the Yin Yang Temple.
Lin Chen just used it as a detection medium, and he had almost no disadvantages.
"This fluctuation, this aura, is even better than Ji Yin Ming Gu!" Lin Chen's eyes widened, and he couldn't help but feel excited.
In the end, the Xiahou family still failed to complete a thorough exploration of the Yin-Yang Temple and did not touch the core of the Yin-Yang Shocking Formation. As a result, they spent such a long time and failed to explore all the creation.
In this second level temple, this Yin Yang Dao Lotus is naturally a supreme treasure, enough to be the envy of the world.
